question: How many people who see a Zomato push notification actually order?
idealClarificationQuestions: Push notification with offer / restaurant recommendation? Yes.
Of all users notification-delivered, what % convert to an order in next 24 hours? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Push delivery → seen → tap → order funnel.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Notifications sent to active users: 1 crore (sample base).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Seen (lock screen / pulled down): ~65% of delivered = 49 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of tappers, ordered within 24 hours: ~25-35% = 70K-1.3 lakh orders.

calculationFlow: Notifications sent to active users: 1 crore (sample base).
Seen (lock screen / pulled down): ~65% of delivered = 49 lakh.
Tapped (clicked through to app): ~3-5% of delivered = 2.5-3.7 lakh.
Of tappers, ordered within 24 hours: ~25-35% = 70K-1.3 lakh orders.
